name: Mandatory Lab Test Report Check
description: Verifies that an authentic lab test report covering heavy metals (Cadmium) is present in the dossier.
statutory_reference: Protocol on Phytosanitary Requirements for Vietnamese Durian to China, Article 4
message_vi: Thiếu Phiếu kết quả kiểm nghiệm kim loại nặng (Cadmi). Container không được phép thông quan.
message_en: Missing required Lab Test Report for heavy metals (Cadmium). Clearance blocked.

name: Mandatory Phytosanitary Certificate Check
description: Verifies that an official Phytosanitary Certificate from Vietnam PPD is present.
message_vi: Thiếu Giấy chứng nhận Kiểm dịch thực vật (Phytosanitary Certificate).

name: Statutory Maximum Cadmium Residue Limit (MRL)
description: Enforces strict statutory limit of 0.050 mg/kg on fresh durian pulp under PRC Food Safety Standard.
statutory_reference: GB 2762-2022 Table 1 (Contaminants in Food - Cadmium in Fresh Fruit)
message_vi: Hàm lượng Cadmi vượt ngưỡng pháp định tối đa của Trung Quốc (0.050 mg/kg). Nguy cơ bị tiêu hủy hoặc quay đầu tại cửa khẩu.
message_en: Cadmium concentration exceeds statutory Chinese MRL (0.050 mg/kg). Critical rejection risk at border.

name: Internal Packhouse Advisory Cadmium Warning
description: Warns when Cadmium level exceeds internal packhouse safety buffer of 0.040 mg/kg due to lab measurement uncertainty (±15%).
statutory_reference: Internal Quality Control Protocol Rev 2.1 (Not a statutory violation)
message_vi: Cảnh báo an toàn nội bộ: Hàm lượng Cadmi tiệm cận mức rủi ro (>0.040 mg/kg). Cần xin phê duyệt Quản lý vựa.
message_en: Internal Safety Margin Warning: Cadmium approaches risk threshold (>0.040 mg/kg). Manager sign-off required.

name: Container Number ISO 6346 Checksum Validation
description: Validates container identification against the standard ISO 6346 modulo 11 algorithm.
statutory_reference: ISO 6346:1995 Freight containers — Coding, identification and marking
message_vi: Số container không hợp lệ theo chuẩn quốc tế ISO 6346 (sai số kiểm tra check digit).
message_en: Container number fails international ISO 6346 check digit validation.

name: Cross-Document Container Number Consistency
description: Verifies that the container number matches 100% identically across Packing List, Phyto, Invoice, and Dossier Header.
governing_authority: General Administration of Customs of China (GACC)
statutory_reference: GACC Clearance Guideline for Border Land Ports (2023 Revision)
message_vi: Số container không đồng nhất giữa các chứng từ (Packing List, Phyto, Invoice, Tờ khai).
message_en: Container number discrepancy detected across dossier documents.

name: Cross-Document Seal Number Consistency
description: Verifies that the customs seal number matches identically between Packing List and Phytosanitary Certificate.
governing_authority: General Administration of Customs of China (GACC)
statutory_reference: GACC Customs Supervision Rules for Sealed Reefers
message_vi: Số niêm phong (seal) không khớp giữa Packing List và Giấy kiểm dịch thực vật.
message_en: Seal number mismatch between Packing List and Phytosanitary Certificate.

name: Lab Sampling vs Stuffing Date Chronology
description: Ensures laboratory sampling date precedes or matches container stuffing date, and is within 14 calendar days.
statutory_reference: PPD Technical Guidelines for Fresh Durian Export Batches
message_vi: Ngày lấy mẫu kiểm nghiệm bất hợp lý (sau ngày đóng container hoặc quá hạn 14 ngày).
message_en: Lab sampling date invalid (post-dates container stuffing or exceeds 14-day validity).

name: Reefer Setpoint Temperature Sanity
description: Verifies reefer container setpoint temperature is within recommended fresh durian range (13.0°C to 15.0°C).
governing_authority: Vietnam Post-Harvest Research Institute / Carrier Cold Treatment SOP
statutory_reference: Post-Harvest Durian Cold Chain Handling Protocol (TCVN 10738:2015)
message_vi: Nhiệt độ cài đặt container ngoài dải khuyến nghị (13.0°C - 15.0°C). Nguy cơ chín sớm hoặc nứt vỏ.
message_en: Target temperature outside recommended range (13.0°C - 15.0°C). Risk of premature ripening or chilling injury.
